decided: When deciding whether a program is finished, a change or an exploration whose settings file cannot be read is treated as belonging to no program, the way the program's stage list already treats it.
alternatives: treat any change whose settings file cannot be read as open work that keeps every program unfinished
stop and ask the user whenever such a file is found
why: Whether a program is finished is read from the same stage list the user sees in orbit architecture status, so the two must read each change the same way.
